sources.title: ATO: Tax reform, better targeting the Research and Development Tax Incentive
sources.fact: Read 26 September 2026 (published 12 May 2026). States the measure is not yet law and that all 7 changes would take effect from 1 July 2028, including removing supporting R&D activities from the offset, restricting refundable offsets to a company's first 10 years of operation and raising the minimum expenditure threshold.
sources.limitations: Announced measure, not law when read. Check its current status before relying on it.
